summary: Elong Power Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K containing notice of an extraordinary general meeting to ratify a previously adopted 45-for-1 share consolidation and related charter amendments. The consolidation took effect on August 10, 2026, and the EGM is scheduled for August 27, 2026. The board recommends voting for all proposals. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic transactions are involved. What to watch: shareholder approval of the ratification and any impact on share price from the reduced share count.
